question: _________ recommend(s) 20 mm wide margins for sheet sizes AO and A1 in engineering drawings.
solution:
The correct answer is __Borders and frames: SP: 46 (2003)****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• SP: 46 (2003)__ is the standard for general engineering drawing practices in India.
 
• It recommends 20 mm wide margins for sheet sizes A0 and A1 in engineering drawings.
 
• This ensures uniformity and clarity in technical drawings.
 
• The borders and frames provide a clean and organized structure for the drawings.
 
• Proper margins allow adequate space for annotations and prevent crowding of information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Grid Reference System:**
 
 
• It is used to specify locations on technical drawings using a grid of letters and numbers.
 
• It helps in identifying specific areas on a drawing for detailed analysis.
 
 
 
• **Custom Grids:**
 
 
• Custom grids are tailored layouts created for specific design or drafting requirements.
 
• They allow flexibility in creating unique patterns or layouts.
 
 
 
• **Geographic Coordinate Systems:**
 
 
• These are used in mapping and geolocation to define positions on Earth using coordinates.
 
• They include latitude, longitude, and elevation data.
